jobs.occupation: Inetum - Senior IT Recruiter (Permanent & Freelance Talent Solutions)
jobs.description:
Inetum is a European leader in digital services. Every day, the Group's 28,000 consultants and specialists aim to make a digital impact for businesses, public sector bodies and society as a whole: solutions that contribute to performance, innovation and the common good.

Present in 19 countries, close to the regions, and with its major software publisher partners, Inetum meets the challenges of digital transformation with proximity and flexibility. Driven by its ambition to grow and industrialize, Inetum generated Sales of EUR2.5 billion in 2023.

In response to a market that has been growing steadily for over 30 years, Inetum has made the deliberate choice to refocus on 4 core businesses in order to gain strength and offer customized solutions tailored to the specific needs of its customers: consulting (Inetum Consulting), infrastructure and application management (Inetum Technologies), software implementation (Inetum Solutions) and its own software publishing business (Inetum Software). Inetum has forged strategic partnerships with 4 of the world's leading software publishers - Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft and SAP - and is pursuing a dedicated acquisition strategy to become one of Europe's top 5 in these technologies, and offer the best expertise to its customers.

At inetum, we offer more than just a job; we provide an inspiring environment and opportunities for growth and development. we strive to create a workplace where you can harness your talents, contribute to challenging projects, and be part of a leading IT consultancy group.

Job description

 
• We are looking for an experienced Senior IT Recruiter to help us attract and engage top technology talent across Belgium. This is a role for someone who enjoys building relationships, identifying opportunities and finding solutions in a competitive talent market.
 
• You have a strong network within the IT sector, are comfortable approaching candidates directly, and know how to build credibility with both candidates and business stakeholders. You combine recruitment expertise with a commercial mindset and enjoy working closely with the business to achieve results.
 
• You will play a key role in attracting both permanent employees and freelance consultants, partnering closely with Business Unit Leaders and Sales teams to support the continued growth of the business.
 
• As a Senior IT Recruitment Partner, you will be responsible for the end-to-end recruitment process for both permanent and freelance IT positions. You will act as a trusted advisor to the business, bringing market insights, challenging assumptions and helping hiring managers make informed talent decisions.

Key responsibilities

 
• Manage the full recruitment lifecycle for permanent and freelance IT profiles
 
• Proactively source and engage high-quality candidates through LinkedIn, networking, referrals, events and other sourcing channels
 
• Build, maintain and leverage a strong network within the IT and technology market
 
• Conduct candidate interviews to ensure both technical and cultural fit
 
• Guide candidates throughout the recruitment process and create an excellent candidate experience
 
• Partner closely with Business Unit Leaders and Sales teams to understand hiring needs and business priorities
 
• Challenge and advise stakeholders on talent availability, market realities and recruitment strategies
 
• Develop creative sourcing approaches to identify niche and hard-to-find profiles
 
• Stay informed about technology trends and developments within the talent market
 
• Act as an ambassador for the company and contribute to strengthening our employer brand

Additional information

...

Experience & skills:

• Minimum 5 years of recruitment experience within IT or technology recruitment

• Proven experience recruiting both permanent employees and freelance consultants

• Strong sourcing capabilities with a track record of successfully filling challenging roles

• Well-established network within the IT and technology community

• Commercial mindset and strong relationship-building skills

• Able to influence, challenge and advise stakeholders at different levels of the organisation

• Genuine interest in technology and the IT market

• Resilient and persistent in your approach to recruitment

• Strong communication and negotiation skills

• Fluent in Dutch and English, both written and spoken

• Knowledge of French is an asset

Due to a large number of opportunities, we are looking for a driven 
Sales Coordinator / Tender Specialist to strengthen the Sarens Projects team. In this role, you aim to provide clients with a structured, solution-oriented, and clear proposal within the agreed timeline. In collaboration with the Key Account Manager, you clarify the proposal and respond to the client's questions. 
 

Your future responsibilities as a Tender Specialist include: 
 

• Analyzing and summarizing client requests. 
 

• Developing proposals for technical requests and projects in collaboration with the responsible Key Account Manager to achieve the best balance between budget, scope, and timing according to client needs. 
 

• During the bidding process, you collaborate with various support departments such as engineering, logistics, HR, SHEQ, finance, etc. You coordinate their input and deliverables while respecting deadlines to create a structured, high-quality proposal that meets both internal and external expectations. 
 

• Regularly consulting with the responsible Key Account Manager and the sales support team about the proposed solution, adjusting as needed. 
 

• Gathering the necessary cost inputs, preparing a price calculation, and reviewing it with the Key Account Manager and/or management. 
 

• Timely and accurately submitting proposals/tender documents after internal approval and following up on them with the Key Account Manager. Responding to internal and external questions and making adjustments where needed. 
 

• Acting at all times as a proud 
Sarens Ambassador and providing general sales support to the group. 

We are looking for a stress-resistant multitasker with a hands-on mentality, strong writing skills, and a solution-focused, positive attitude. You have a strong interest in the world of specialized transport and heavy lifting. You possess good reading and listening skills, enabling you to detect and anticipate customer needs. You think outside the box in search of the best solution. You are a sociable team player with a strong sense of responsibility. You work in a structured and precise manner, with attention to detail. Customer focus, drive, and proactivity are key to success in this role. 
 

Your profile: 
 

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a technical field (engineering, electromechanics, construction...) or equivalent through experience. 
 

• Interest in or experience with sales support, technical inside sales, tender engineering, etc. 
 

• Technical knowledge of heavy lifting and/or exceptional transport, or a strong eagerness to learn and acquire this knowledge quickly. • Strong communicator in Dutch; good knowledge of English and French. 
 

• Proficient with computers (including MS Office).

We are seeking an experienced forklift operator to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for the efficient and safe movement of goods within our warehouse. You have a keen eye for detail and strive for perfection in every task you undertake.

• Expertly operate and maneuver the forklift for loading, unloading, and relocating goods.

• Accurately inspect and record incoming and outgoing shipments.

• Maintain an organized and orderly workspace by placing goods in their designated locations.

• Conduct daily maintenance checks on the forklift and report any issues or damages.

• Actively contribute to the compliance with safety and health regulations in the workplace.

• Willingness to do fysical work.

If you are looking for a job in the harbour in a logistic envoirement, have no doubt and apply for this function!

• Minimum of 3 years of experience as a forklift operator.

• Thorough knowledge of forklift operations.

• Excellent understanding of safety and health regulations.

• Physically fit and capable of working in shifts.

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

• Team player with effective communication skills in Dutch or English

For our client in Beernem, we are looking for an experienced tiler.
 

You will join a young and dynamic team.
 

Be sure to apply if you are interested!
 

 
 

 

 
 

 
• You are a worker with several years of experience in tiling
 
• A driving licence is required!
 
• You speak fluent Dutch or English
 
• You have a VCA certificate or are willing to obtain one

For a leading US company with its European headquarters in Brussels, we are looking for an Accounting Specialist. You will join an international environment where Finance, Operations, HR, Tax, and Real Estate work closely together. This role exists to ensure that accounting and reporting processes across multiple markets are carried out accurately and on time. We are looking for someone who is analytically strong, communicates fluently, and feels comfortable in a dynamic and collaborative culture.

Your responsibilities

• 
Coordinate the administration of invoices and obligations related to leasing, housekeeping, payroll, property taxes, and travel expenses.

• 
Monitor budgets and analyze deviations in recurring costs and monthly closings.

• 
Oversee reconciliations, intercompany positions, and payroll reconciliations.

• 
Prepare VAT, property tax, and other tax filings in collaboration with the Tax department.

• 
Support external audits, year-end closing, and the preparation of statutory financial statements.

• 
Assist in the integration of new or acquired stores into accounting processes.

• 
Contribute to ESG data collection, budget preparation, and process improvements.

• 
Support and coach team members and new colleagues where necessary.

Your profile

• 
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or equivalent experience.

• 
At least 5 years of experience in accounting.

• 
Experience with financial statements, IFRS, and local GAAP.

• 
Experience in services or retail is required.

• 
Experience with SAP; knowledge of SAP S/4HANA is a plus.

• 
Experience with ERP/CRM migrations and UAT is an advantage.

• 
Fluent in English and French; German is a strong plus.

• 
Strong skills in Excel and Microsoft Office.

• 
Accurate, independent, communicative, and solution-oriented.

For a growing organisation in the services sector we are looking for a Finance Operations Specialist. 

You will work closely with local accounting teams and other internal stakeholders across Europe.

Your Responsibilities

• 
Monitor expenses and commitments for real estate projects across Europe

• 
Support the preparation and review of local GAAP accounting memos

• 
Manage the daily administration of invoices and purchase orders

• 
Review and analyze invoice postings, including VAT and entity details

• 
Analyze new real estate projects such as construction, renovation, and maintenance

• 
Support communication with external parties such as contractors, suppliers, and government authorities

• 
Assist with the financial reporting of investment projects (actuals, budget, and forecast)

• 
Follow up on payment schedules together with local accounting teams

• 
Support month-end and quarter-end closings within real estate accounting

• 
Assist with depreciation, capitalization, and reconciliations

• 
Support internal and external audits

• 
Contribute to ESG reporting

• 
Assist in implementing procedures and control systems in line with internal standards

• 
Support the rollout of control processes across different markets

• 
Support process improvements and special accounting projects

Your Profile

• 
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or equivalent experience

• 
1–3 years of experience in accounting

• 
Experience in a real estate environment is a plus

• 
Fluent in English

• 
Experience in an international or shared services environment is a plus

• 
Knowledge of IFRS and local GAAP is an asset

• 
Proficient in Microsoft Office, with advanced Excel skills

• 
Experience with SAP S/4HANA is a plus

jobs.occupation: Cream Consulting by Audensiel - Functional Analyst in Energy Domain
jobs.description:
What IS cream all about ?

We could be a Cream Factory, a cooking blog or even a detective agency...

But in reality, we are a Business & Technology consulting company, active in large organizations and industry leaders in Banking, Insurance, Telecom, Energy, & Transport.

The Cream recipe:

- 1/3 personal development - 1/3 collective intelligence - 1/3 intrapreneurship - bonus ingredient: some passionate colleagues

Your future projects :

Like Morgane, Functional Analyst at Cream, you act as a bridge between business and IT teams within the banking sector. You translate business needs into functional specifications for digital platforms such as mobile applications, AI solutions or e-Commerce tools. Your projects may relate to payments, credit or compliance for example.

Our clients of the energy sector produce and transport electricity and gas for the Belgian market. To support their specific business issues, they develop in-house IT products.

In order to run Energy projects related to smart metering, electrical network stability, customers and contracts management, gas flow management, legal regulations, real time data management, energy management trading, Grid maintenance and development, etc. the Functional Analyst captures, consolidates and communicates the information from the various business stakeholders to the IT teams in order to provide them the necessary pieces of information to create a new solution.
Your tasks will be

• Translating business requirements into a structured IT solution while keeping a functional approach

• Using your energy industry knowledge to help translating this functional design into well-tailored technical design

• Collaborating with the business analysts for proper translation of the needs

• Preparing functional integration test cases based on the requirements

• Testing of the product before delivery to the users

• Analysing potential corrective actions to be taken

• Following up of technical designers and programmers

• Being able to go into technical details

• Working closely with the business to ensure the final solution fits their needs

What do we expect from our Consultant ?

• You have a Master Degree in information technologies, electricity, electronics or equivalent

• You have a proven experience in Functional Analysis

• Very good knowledge of Energy Market issues and modelling tools and methodologies among others:

• generation, transportation, metering, billing, Grid management, asset management, contract management, gas flow management, risk management, portfolio management, power optimization, energy trading, real time applications ... as you can interact with energy markets specialiss

• UML, RUP...

• An experience in IT projects based on Microsoft architecture (.NET, Visual Studio, SQL Server, TFS) could be a real asset

• Nice to have: knowledge of a testing framework or automation tool (NUnit, QTP)

• You are able to make the bridge between technical and business experts worlds

• You can meet project deadlines and provide high quality deliverables

• You have high communications skills and analytical skills

• You are rigorous

• You are capable to think out of the box and maintain in the meantime a pragmatic approach.

• You are able to work with autonomy while being also a great team player

• You are fluent in French and English, a good knowledge of Dutch is also required

• You are committed to travelling abroad occasionally upon the client's request

-

For an international production company specializing in high-quality technologies in Izegem, we are looking for a CNC Machine Loader (day shift).

What will you do?

• Loading and unloading CNC machines: inserting and removing parts based on the production order
• Ensuring an optimal production flow, both for series and single-piece work
• Performing fine deburring work on produced parts
• Carrying out quality controls on machined parts
• Replacing tools and making corrections where necessary
• Contributing to an orderly and tidy workplace with an eye for safety

Who are you?

• Background in metal or CNC
• Good fine motor skills and eye for detail
• Strong mechanical insight and ability to read technical drawings
• Team player with a strong sense of responsibility
• Willing to work in a 2-shift system
• Good knowledge of English

We are looking for a Technical Assistant to support the PALL (Product Assessment & Laundry Laboratory) team during a temporary assignment. In this hands-on role, you will perform laundry and wash performance tests, take technical measurements before and after washing cycles, maintain laboratory stock, and ensure accurate data collection and reporting. You will work in a team of three Technical Assistants and receive training on various testing methods and equipment.

In a nutshell you will: 

 
• Perform laundry and wash performance tests according to established procedures. 
 

 
• Take measurements using laboratory equipment (e.g. spectrophotometer). 
 
• Record, verify, and upload test data accurately. 
Maintain testing materials and laboratory stock. 

 
• Communicate with internal stakeholders regarding test requests, observations, and results. 
 
•  
Report any irregularities or unexpected findings during testing.

 
• Available full-time from September 22 through December 23. 
 

 
• Able to work daily from 7:30 AM to 4:00 PM. 
 
•  
Accurate, reliable, and detail-oriented. 

 
•  
Comfortable working in a practical, laboratory-based environment. 

 
• Good communication skills in English. 
 

 
• Basic computer skills (Outlook, Excel, and willingness to learn internal systems). 
 

 
• Open to coaching and eager to learn new testing methods. 
 
•  
Able to handle laundry baskets of approximately 3 kg using provided ergonomic equipment.

We are looking for an enthusiastic CNC miller for our production department.
 
Our client develops and manufactures modular systems for the live communications sector.
 
As a CNC miller, you will mill aluminum profiles according to drawings.
 
You will alternate between batch production and custom work.
 
In addition, you will use an ERP system to process production orders.
 
You will also be responsible for creating milling programs, setting up the milling machine, loading and unloading the machine, and performing quality checks.
 
Furthermore, you will perform first-line maintenance on the machine. 

• Experience as a CNC miller

• Ability to read blueprints and knowledge of using measuring instruments

• Quality-oriented, with a sense of order and neatness

• You are fluent in English

• Willing to work in a two-shift system

• Team player with a positive attitude
